weather.summary: Mostly Sunny then Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms
weather.blurb: A slight chance of showers after lunch, which is new around here.

air.blurb: Fine for most of us. If your lungs are touchy, take it a little easy.

lake.blurb: The lake is close to full — good for boats and for the summer water supply. Down a touch from last week.

pollen.blurb: Ragweed and grasses are up. Allergy folks, take the pill before it takes you.

grid.blurb: Normal conditions: demand near 85,700 megawatts, with 103,900 on hand.

sun.blurb: The sun is up for 12 hours and 46 minutes today, and down by 7:53 p.m.
